test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Don't you teach English to seventh graders?

options.text: Don't English taught by you to seventh graders?
Do English taught by you to seventh graders?
Isn't English taught by you to seventh graders?
Did English taught by you to seventh graders?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Don't you teach English to seventh graders?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "English" at the beginning.
